description: List and filter the recent sent-email delivery history shown in the dashboard. Search subject/title or recipient, filter by delivery status, email type, bounce type, source ID, recipient mailbox provider, or list membership, then pass a returned emailSendId to get_email_send for exact open/click timestamps and the complete event timeline. Each row carries recipientEmail, subscriberId, automationNodeId, abTestVariantId, and sent/delivered/opened/clicked timestamps, so rows join into a recipient-level delivery matrix without re-reading the raw event stream. Pass automationNodeId to list only the recipients of one sequence step. Delivery rows are retained for 14 days, so this is the wrong tool for send totals: read get_sequence_stats steps[] or list_email_metrics, which cover the full retained event window. Successful live-test and other test sends are omitted so they do not bury real deliveries; only failed, bounced, or suppressed test sends appear. Replies to those test sends show in list_conversations only when inbound reply capture is enabled; otherwise the send uses the original Reply-To and Sequenzy never sees the reply.

automationNodeId.description: Filter deliveries from one email step of a sequence, using the nodeId from get_sequence_stats steps[] or get_sequence nodes.

bounceType.description: Bounce type: Permanent, Transient, Soft, or Blocked. Transient is every temporary bounce; Blocked is the part the receiver refused on content, policy, or reputation grounds, and Soft is the rest.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

days.description: History window in days, from 1 to 14. Defaults to 14.

emailType.description: Email type: campaign, transactional, or sequence.

limit.description: Results per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

listId.description: Only deliveries to active subscribers currently on this list (list ID from list_lists), the same audience the analytics list filter uses.

mailboxProvider.description: Recipient mailbox provider, with the same values and domain classification as the analytics mailboxProvider filter (e.g. gmail, microsoft, yahoo, icloud, orange). Use it to list the deliveries behind a provider's analytics numbers. `other` matches every domain outside the named providers.

page.description: Page number starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

search.description: Case-insensitive search across subject and recipient email.

sortField.description: Sort field: recipientEmail, subject, status, eventAt, sentAt, or createdAt. Defaults to createdAt.

sortOrder.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

status.description: Delivery status: pending, sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained, failed, or suppressed. Opened includes clicked deliveries, matching the dashboard.

transactionalEmailId.description: Filter deliveries from one saved transactional email.

name: list_email_sends

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_email_sends` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

emailSends.description: List of email send, with outcome (bounced, blocked, delayed or failed) and reason for an email that didn't arrive records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

pagination.description: The email send pagination record returned by Sequenzy.

retentionDays.description: Number of days sent-email rows remain queryable in this collection.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
